title: Our University. Part 1: Modern Times

lines: Topic 1. OUR UNIVERSITY (PART 1: MODERN TIMES)
Stepan Gzhytskyi National University of Veterinary Medicine and Biotechnologies Lviv is one of the state higher schools.
There are two forms of studying at our University: full-time and extra-mural.
There are about 30 chairs at the University.
More than 300 lecturers and professors work here.
The University is run by the Rector and the faculties are headed by Deans.
Our University trains veterinary doctors, technologists of production and processing of animal products, ecologists, managers, marketing specialists, and many others.
Some students will graduate with a degree of a bachelor, the others will go on to do a second degree of a master.
There are also postgraduates who do researches and prepare to get a PhD.
The University has five educational buildings with many lecture-halls, classrooms and laboratories.
Four hostels, two libraries, four clinics, a sports complex and a sports camp are at the students' disposal.
There are three museums at the University: the Museum of University's History, the Museum of Horseshoes, and the Anatomical Museum.
TASK 2 (мої відповіді)
1. The name of my higher school is Stepan Gzhytskyi National University of Veterinary Medicine and Biotechnologies Lviv.
2. I study at the Faculty of Veterinary Medicine.
3. There're two forms of studying: full-time and extra-mural.
4. There're about 30 chairs at the University.
5. The University is run by the Rector.
6. The faculties are headed by Deans.
7. Our students will become veterinary doctors, technologists, ecologists, managers, marketing specialists, and etc.
8. There're 5 educational buildings, lecture-halls, classrooms, laboratories, four hostels, two libraries, four clinics, a sports complex and a sports camp.
9. There're 3 museums: the Museum of University's History, the Museum of Horseshoes, and the Anatomical Museum.
TASK 4. Present Indefinite (мої речення)
1. Our higher school trains veterinary students and other specialists.
2. Deans do not head the university.
3. A rector doesn't run the faculty.
4. Our state needs well-educated specialists?
5. Does your friend study at the University too?
6. The students attend practical classes in laboratories.
7. Our University is one of sixteen state higher schools in Lviv.
8. Are there 3 museums at the University?
9. There aren't any texts about economics in this book.

corrections.asWritten: Deans do not don't head the university
corrections.correct: Deans do not head the university.
corrections.note: у зошиті двічі написано заперечення: do not і don't — треба одне

corrections.correct: Does our state need well-educated specialists?
corrections.note: у завданні знак питання — отже потрібне питальне речення з do/does, а дієслово без -s
etc. = et cetera, «and» уже всередині; «and etc.» — тавтологія

checks: Речення 7 у Task 4: підручник дає «one of sixteen state higher schools in Lviv» — перевір цифру на парі, у сучасних джерелах кількість інша.
There're / There aren't — у письмових роботах скорочення краще розкривати: There are, There are not.
